description: Test suite for quic_utils functions in the quiche/quic library, including address change detection, hash functions, connection ID generation, and packet header identification.

classes.name: QuicUtilsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for quic_utils tests.

methods.name: DetermineAddressChangeType
methods.description: Tests the detection of address change types between socket addresses.

methods.name: IncrementalHashReference
methods.description: Computes a hash of data using a custom incremental hash algorithm.

methods.name: ReferenceTest
methods.description: Verifies that IncrementalHashReference matches the FNV1a_128_Hash implementation.

methods.name: IsUnackable
methods.description: Checks if packet states are considered unackable.

methods.name: RetransmissionTypeToPacketState
methods.description: Maps transmission types to packet states.

methods.name: IsIetfPacketHeader
methods.description: Determines if a packet header byte indicates an IETF QUIC packet.

methods.name: RandomConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a random connection ID of default length.

methods.name: RandomConnectionIdVariableLength
methods.description: Generates a random connection ID of specified length.

methods.name: VariableLengthConnectionId
methods.description: Tests variable length connection ID validity for different versions.

methods.name: StatelessResetToken
methods.description: Tests generation and comparison of stateless reset tokens.

methods.name: EcnCodepointToString
methods.description: Converts ECN codepoints to string representations.
